title: DAGR SRS deterministic verification report v0.2 (with subject-reference origin disclosure)
description: Deterministic results of one ARCS Verify invocation over one signed DAGR SRS receipt (srs.mcp.sdk_enforcement.v0.1 only). Identical to the frozen v0.1 report except for the two version identifiers and the single added field subject_ref_origin_disclosed. Contains no wall-clock time, random identifiers, hostnames, or temporary paths. Unknown fields fail closed: this schema defines no extension location.

report_version.description: Version of this report contract, not the arcs-verify package version.

receipt_id.description: Verbatim receipt_id copied from the verified receipt.

receipt_kind.description: This contract covers only the DAGR MCP receipt-emitter/runtime binding's admission and outcome receipt kinds under srs.mcp.sdk_enforcement.v0.1. Other profiles (e.g. srs.connection.lifecycle.v0.1) are out of scope, exactly as in v0.1.

receipt_artifact_hash.description: sha256(RFC8785-JCS(complete accepted receipt JSON object, including receipt_signature)), lowercase hex, no prefix. Unchanged from v0.1; defined authoritatively in the v0.1 receipt-hash-contract.json.

supported_receipt_contract_id.description: Verbatim profile_id identity this report was verified against.

supported_receipt_contract_version.description: Verbatim profile_version identity this report was verified against. Profile semantics are versioned separately from the envelope: reading a v0.2.1 envelope field does not move the profile version.

verifier_commit.description: Full git commit SHA of the arcs-verify checkout that performed this verification. Never a mutable ref such as 'main' or 'latest'.

verifier_entrypoint.description: The pinned console-script target that performs the eight-Boolean verification this report wraps.

verifier_configuration_digest.description: sha256(RFC8785-JCS) over {envelope_schema_sha256, receipt_version, selected_profile}. envelope_schema_sha256 names the pinned envelope schema actually used: the retained v0.2.0 pin for historical receipts, or the v0.2.1 pin. The recipe is unchanged from v0.1, so a v0.2.0-schema verification yields the identical digest v0.1 yields.

trust_bundle_digest.description: sha256(RFC8785-JCS(complete trust-bundle JSON object)) actually used for this verification. Recording this digest does not assert the trust bundle was authorized; only that it is the exact artifact used.

verdicts.description: Exactly the eight existing Boolean ARCS verdict fields, unchanged in name, meaning, and value from v0.1. chain_status is NOT a ninth verdict and MUST NOT appear here. subject_ref_origin_disclosed is NOT a verdict and MUST NOT appear here.

chain_status.description: Reported separately from verdicts, never a ninth Boolean, and unchanged from v0.1. This contract only reaches not_applicable for standalone signed DAGR receipts; a widened domain requires a new contract version.

subject_ref_origin_disclosed.description: Disclosure, never a verdict. The five declared values are copied verbatim from a well-formed SRS envelope v0.2.1 subject_ref_origin. not_declared means the field was genuinely absent from the receipt and nothing more: it is not evidence of emitter vintage and must not be collapsed into any supplied class. not_declared is a report rendering only; it is not a member of the envelope enum and is never an emitted receipt value. A present but out-of-vocabulary subject_ref_origin is invalid input and is never rendered here. No value of this field can upgrade, downgrade, override, excuse, or replace any Boolean verdict or chain_status.

failure_codes.description: Deterministic failure-code strings from the underlying verification (never raw receipt content or free-form error text). Unchanged from v0.1: origin disclosure contributes no failure code.
